items.distractor_fact: У суседном селу је истог јутра термометар показивао {D} °C.
items.gloss_en: In the neighboring village, that same morning, the thermometer showed {D} °C.
items.entity_note: a different village's thermometer, not the terrace one the story compares

items.distractor_fact: Акција другог предузећа тог дана коштала је {D} €.
items.gloss_en: That day, another company's share cost {D} €.
items.entity_note: a different company's share price, not the one the question tracks

items.distractor_fact: Мерна станица суседне реке забележила је ниво од {D} cm.
items.gloss_en: The gauge station on the neighboring river recorded a level of {D} cm.
items.entity_note: a different river's gauge station, not the one before/after the rain

items.distractor_fact: Оближњи врх на карти означен је висином од {D} m.
items.gloss_en: A nearby peak on the map is marked with an altitude of {D} m.
items.entity_note: a different mountain peak, not the hiker's own climb

items.distractor_fact: Тег у оближњој теретани показивао је {D} kg.
items.gloss_en: The scale at a nearby gym showed {D} kg.
items.entity_note: a different gym's scale, not the one the athlete used all season

items.distractor_fact: Са другог рачуна у истој банци подигнуто је {D} $.
items.gloss_en: From another account at the same bank, {D} $ was withdrawn.
items.entity_note: a different bank account than the one being tracked

items.distractor_fact: Његов сапутник је током истог путовања потрошио {D} $.
items.gloss_en: His travel companion spent {D} $ during the same trip.
items.entity_note: a different traveler (the companion), not the traveler in the question

items.distractor_fact: Друга продавница истог ланца имала је трошкове од {D} $.
items.gloss_en: Another store in the same chain had expenses of {D} $.
items.entity_note: a different store in the chain, not the shop the question is about

items.distractor_fact: Други инвеститор је на својој позицији остварио губитак од {D} $.
items.gloss_en: Another investor made a loss of {D} $ on their own position.
items.entity_note: a different investor, not the one whose net result is asked

items.distractor_fact: Друга фабрика истог концерна произвела је {D} комада тог месеца.
items.gloss_en: Another factory in the same conglomerate produced {D} units that month.
items.entity_note: a different factory with its own unstated plan

items.distractor_fact: Друга продавница истог ланца остварила је продају од {D} $.
items.gloss_en: Another store in the same chain achieved sales of {D} $.
items.entity_note: a different store with its own unstated sales target

items.distractor_fact: У суседном граду измерено је {D} mm падавина тог месеца.
items.gloss_en: In the neighboring town, {D} mm of rainfall was measured that month.
items.entity_note: a different town with its own unstated forecast

items.distractor_fact: Други воз на супротном смеру стигао је у тренутку који је износио {D} минута.
items.gloss_en: Another train, on the opposite line, arrived at a moment amounting to {D} minutes.
items.entity_note: a different train and line, with its own unstated timetable

items.distractor_fact: У суседној згради лифт се зауставио на спрату означеном бројем {D}.
items.gloss_en: In the neighboring building, the elevator stopped at the floor marked number {D}.
items.entity_note: a different building's elevator, with its own floor numbering

items.distractor_fact: Предузеће Гама остварило је добит од {D} $ у истом кварталу.
items.gloss_en: Company Gamma achieved a profit of {D} $ in the same quarter.
items.entity_note: a third company, distinct from Alfa and Beta

items.distractor_fact: Тркач Јовановић је на истој трци постигао време од {D} s.
items.gloss_en: Runner Jovanović posted a time of {D} s in the same race.
items.entity_note: a third runner, distinct from Milić and Radović
